name: columnist-db
description: AI Memory Tool for LLM Context Management - Persistent memory storage for AI assistants

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck && next build
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/core run clean && npm --prefix packages/core run build && npm --prefix packages/hooks run clean && npm --prefix packages/hooks run build && npm --prefix packages/plugins/openai-embedding run clean && npm --prefix packages/plugins/openai-embedding run build && npm --prefix packages/rag-db run clean && npm --prefix packages/rag-db run build
scripts.pack:check: npm run build:packages && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); ['packages/core','packages/hooks','packages/plugins/openai-embedding','packages/rag-db'].forEach((dir) => execSync('npm pack --dry-run', { cwd: dir, stdio: 'inherit' }));"
